subject: Intro: Hosted API pricing per 1M tokens & available model list
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@veloxai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Quick Q — per-1M token pricing (input/output) + model list

Hi Karthik,

Quick intro — I’m Sara, Head of Platform at VeloxAI. We’re evaluating hosted inference providers for a new assistant feature and I wanted to get baseline pricing before we schedule time. Two quick asks: 1) What are your standard per-1M token rates for input vs output on the hosted API (USD), and 2) Can you send the list of models you currently offer via the hosted API with the recommended cost/perf pairing (low-cost, balanced, high-capacity)?

We expect initial volume of ~10M tokens/month and may scale quickly. Any standard volume discount buckets or committed tiers would be helpful to know.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if easier.

Sara Nguyen
Head of Platform | VeloxAI
(sara.nguyen@veloxai.com)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@veloxai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick Q — per-1M token pricing (input/output) + model list

Hi Sara — great to meet you over email, and thanks for the clear asks. Below is a concise baseline for hosted (public API) pricing and a high-level model availability note. I attached our Q4 ratecard PDF for full tables and terms.

Baseline hosted API (effective Q4 2026) — list prices, USD per 1M tokens:
- Input tokens: $0.60 per 1M tokens (applies to prompt/embedded input)
- Output tokens: $1.20 per 1M tokens (generation/response tokens)

Recommended model buckets (available via hosted API):
- Low-cost / high throughput: "RWD-compact-3B" — good for classification/short completions, lowest unit cost.
- Balanced (cost/quality): "RWD-medium-7B" — general-purpose, lower latency, balanced accuracy.
- High-capacity / best quality: "RWD-large-70B" and "RWD-xlarge-200B" — for long-form generation and complex reasoning (higher token costs).

Notes on pricing behavior:
- Model-dependent multipliers: the list prices above reflect our baseline mix using the balanced model. Compact models typically see ~40–60% lower output cost; large/xlarge models are ~2–3x output rate relative to baseline. Exact per-model effective price is in the attached ratecard and model catalog link.
- Volume discounts: standard tiers start at committed monthly spend thresholds (3 months minimum): 50k USD/month -> 8% discount, 150k USD/month -> 15% discount, enterprise reserved contracts available for deeper discounts and SLA.

Latency/throughput guidance and next steps:
- For your 10M tokens/month (starter), most customers pilot on RWD-medium-7B for balancing cost and latency. If you expect interactive chat with low latency, compact or medium are typical.
- I attached the ratecard and included a model catalog link with per-model performance notes.

If it helps, Ben (cc’d) can run a quick cost projection with your assumed prompt/response lengths and traffic profile. Happy to set a 20-min call tomorrow to align.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of GTM Engineering | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Attachment: Redwood_Hosted_Ratecard_2026Q4.pdf

From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@veloxai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick Q — per-1M token pricing (input/output) + model list

Thanks Karthik — this is really helpful. A couple follow-ups: 1) Can you confirm the breakout between input vs output for compact vs large models? (e.g., is input pricing constant but output model-dependent?) 2) For the discount tiers you listed, do those apply to host usage only or also to embedding calls? 3) Any trial credits or pilot pricing you recommend for a short POC?

Also, curious about regional availability — do you have EU-hosted endpoints and is pricing different there?

If you and Ben can send a quick example cost model (we'll share typical prompt/response sizes), we can decide on the pilot model.

— Sara

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@veloxai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick Q — per-1M token pricing (input/output) + model list

Hi Sara — Ben here, happy to scope a short POC cost projection. Quick answers inline: 
1) Input vs output: input is charged at the baseline rate but output scales by model multiplier. So your cost formula is (input_tokens * input_rate) + (output_tokens * output_rate * model_multiplier). Compact models have a model_multiplier ~0.5; large models are ~2.0–3.0 depending on model.
2) Discounts: the tier discounts apply across hosted API usage (generation + embeddings) unless you opt into a reserved capacity contract which has separate terms for Dedicated. Embeddings have a slightly different base rate (embeddings: $2.50 per 1M vector tokens) — full pricing in the attached PDF.
3) Pilot credits: we typically offer a $5k pilot credit for new strategic POCs for qualifying accounts; can convert to a short-term discounted rate if you sign a 3-month commit.

Regional note: we operate hosted endpoints in us-east, us-west, and eu-west regions. EU-hosted endpoints carry a ~+7% regional premium for data residency and additional infra costs; this is reflected in the region column of the ratecard.

If you share a short CSV with expected daily active users, average prompt length, and avg response length, I’ll run day/month cost estimates for each candidate model and return a matrix by EOD.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
